evals.prompt: I need to write this week's newsletter. The topic is: Live proposal builder — connects to a meeting tool like Granola, listens to a sales call, pulls from past proposals and generates a personalized draft in real time. Our readers are founders who do B2B sales.
evals.expected_output: Full workflow newsletter with TLDR, 4-8 steps, full prompts written out, limitations section, soft CTA. Should research Granola's actual API capabilities before deciding architecture. Should not assume any specific architecture pattern upfront.

evals.prompt: Help me roll out the next newsletter. Topic: founders are spending hours every week manually writing LinkedIn posts from their meeting notes. I want a workflow that takes Notion meeting notes and turns them into 3 ready-to-post LinkedIn drafts automatically.
evals.expected_output: Full workflow newsletter. Should research the topic landscape first, then tools (Notion API, Zapier, Make, Claude API, etc.), present options to user, then write article in house style.

evals.prompt: Write a workflow article for founders on how to build a client onboarding system using AI — right now they're sending the same intro emails and docs manually every time a new client signs.
evals.expected_output: Should first clarify the pain/trigger/output, then research tools, then produce newsletter. Should be medium complexity — not just 'use an email template', but also not requiring custom backend infra.
